thread:
Nina: Follow-up to the migration RFC \u2014 proposing a 'compat-baton' at the gateway: gateway does minimal shape fixes, then sets header X-Compat-Baton: held and runtime consumes it to avoid double-transform. Opt-in per-tenant. Goal: reduce client breakage with minimal runtime churn.
Carlos: Love the baton idea. Key tradeoff: who owns mappings? gateway takes ops burden; runtime takes complexity.
Eve: Also think about streaming: baton should include a short manifest frame so runtime knows frames are already translated.\nNina: Proposal: gateway transforms only idempotent, stateless renames and emits X-Compat-Baton: v1->v2; runtime checks the header and skips heavy normalization.
Carlos: Telemetry we need: compat_baton_invoked, compat_baton_latency_ms, compat_baton_missed_keys. Tag by tenant_id + route.
Eve: Cache keys: compute canonical_cache_key(input, stable_schema_hash) in both layers so cache hits remain stable. If mapping loses keys, add key-alias header.
Nina: For ambiguous mappings (freeform->structured) default to forward-with-warning header X-Compat-Warn and tombstone original to S3 if tenant has debug enabled. Strict mode returns 422.
Carlos: Security: no eval, mappings must be declarative. sec-bot please schedule a mapping audit.
ops-bot: Created alert "compat_baton_error_rate" -> page if >1% for 10m across >=5 tenants. Dashboard panel "Compat Baton - invocations/latency" added.
sec-bot: Will run transformation audit and require redaction rules before any logging.
Eve: Pseudocode:
```
if header X-Compat-Optin == "true":
  if simple_rename_mapping(payload): apply, set header X-Compat-Baton: applied
  else if strict_mode: return 422
  else: add header X-Compat-Warn and forward original
```
Nina: Rollout: internal 3 tenants -> beta 20 -> broad. Metrics gates: compat_baton_error_rate, p99_latency_delta, cache_hit_ratio. Action items: Eve -> envoy filter sketch + perf (48h), Carlos -> mapping whitelist + playbook (24h), Nina -> telemetry/alerts (24h). Revisit in sync. :white_check_mark:
